subject: [PATCH v5 18/22] fuse: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch converts the iomap operations in the fuse file system to use the new ->iomap_next() callback. The conversion is done using macros that wrap the iomap_iter_next helper to finish previous mappings and produce the next one. No functional changes are intended, and the patch only updates the implementation of the iomap operations.
